beats.title: Area 1 · Rockseeker camp and the descent
beats.tv: Reveal the camp and visible pit. Cave-entrance art is E01; keep later rooms covered.
read: Three bedrolls surround a silent camp. Supplies lie where their owners left them. A dwarf’s body rests among the bundles, and a rope tied around a stone spire drops into a break in the cavern floor.

The rope is the clearest connection between this camp and the space below. Its fastening and the edge of the pit can be examined before anyone descends. The bundles and the body offer separate questions, and you can leave room for someone to keep watch while the others decide where to begin.
ask: Do you examine the camp, tend to the dead, secure the rope, or watch the passages below?
run: The dead dwarf is Tharden, Gundren’s brother, killed by Nezznar. Nundro was captured and is in area 20; the camp alone does not tell the characters his current location.
Useful ordinary provisions and mining equipment remain. Tharden wears boots of striding and springing; record discovery, identification, and ownership separately.
The pit is 10 feet wide and 20 feet deep. Without a rope, climbing its wall requires DC 15 Strength (Athletics). Failing by 5 or more causes a fall: 1d6 bludgeoning per 10 feet fallen, then prone.
From the pit bottom, the northwest passage leads to area 2; the east passage leads to area 3. The existing rope offers a practical way down; do not apply the no-rope DC to every descent.
choices: Return to the surface using the actual secured route.
private: Lost Mine of Phandelver p. 44; marked map p. 43. Boots: appendix A. Do not show the corpse as Nundro.
